truths.claim: 用户可打开任意 PDF 并连续滚动阅读，横向自适应屏幕宽度
truths.evidence: PdfRenderService renders all pages via PDFium, ItemsControl displays pages vertically, ScaleTransform handles fit-to-width via ZoomLevel binding

truths.claim: 画笔可选颜色在 PDF 页面上自由标注，橡皮可调大小擦除笔迹
truths.evidence: InkCanvas overlay per page with EditingMode bound to ActiveTool, ToolbarViewModel.PenColors palette, DefaultDrawingAttributes bound to SelectedColor

truths.claim: 一键清屏清除当前所有批注
truths.evidence: ClearAllCommand iterates all PageModel.Strokes and calls Clear(), button wired in XAML toolbar

truths.claim: 可缩放查看 PDF 及批注，批注跟随缩放不漂移
truths.evidence: ScaleTransform on ItemsControl container handles both Image and InkCanvas uniformly, ZoomLevel property (0.5-4.0), Ctrl+Wheel handler

truths.claim: 批注可保存为独立文件，重新打开 PDF 时可恢复之前的批注
truths.evidence: AnnotationFileService.SaveAnnotations serializes per-page StrokeCollection to base64 ISF in JSON, LoadAnnotations restores on PDF open

truths.claim: 生成单个 exe 文件，在其他 Win10+ 机器上免安装直接运行
truths.evidence: publish/PdfTeachAnnotator.exe (160MB), PublishSingleFile=true + SelfContained=true in csproj, app.manifest with PerMonitorV2 and Win10 supportedOS GUIDs
